content: Advance M0130/W0135 with a host-independent persistent cache repository that composes CacheFileStore persistence with CacheCatalog residency, hydration, live-reference pinning, and quota/eviction while preserving deterministic keys and leaving cross-process stampede, pipeline creation, and physical driver qualification open.

The repository serializes catalog and file operations at one boundary. A persistent lookup first checks resident entries, then validates and hydrates one file entry into the bounded catalog; a publish writes the durable envelope only after catalog admission is known, and rejects pinned/quota cases without overwriting their files. Cross-process coordination remains a separate future boundary.

Content revision e1288c1 adds PersistentCacheRepository with catalog admission before file publication, resident-first lookup, validated disk hydration, serialized pin/unpin, and device invalidation. CacheCatalog now exposes mode-aware lookup and remove admission for the repository boundary.

The repository cache regression covers cross-instance hydration, LRU eviction with persistent files retained, pinned publish protection, quota rejection, and device invalidation. The focused cache test and full Vulkan CTest passed 88/88; cross-process stampede and pipeline-bound invalidation remain open.
